conflicts_pre_gate1.annotation: The proposal states the Y1 target as 75% while the logframe export records 0.75 (a ratio). These may represent the same underlying quantity expressed in different units (percentage vs decimal proportion), which would make this a UNIT_GRANULARITY issue rather than a true value disagreement. However, because the surface forms are non-identical and the unit of the logframe cell is not explicitly labelled, this is flagged as a VALUE_MISMATCH for Gate-1 human review to confirm whether 0.75 = 75% or whether a genuine discrepancy exists.
